name: FNAF All-Stars
storyline:
The game takes place in a strange Freddy's location that has not long been left to rot. It was made to be a more mature location for bigger kids, with sitcom-like performances from the animatronics, more mainstream songs, and more arcades geared towards teens. The location wouldn't last very long, and became nothing more than a footnote in the company's history.

Supposedly, Fazbear Entertainment is interested in salvaging the animatronics left in the location, so it's your job to make sure nothing happens to them as the nightwatch. But of course, as these things always go, the robots walk at night and start closing in on you.

Will you survive five nights? I'd like to see you try!
summary: FNaF All-Stars is a bite-sized Fnaf experience that aims to be on the short-but-sweet side of things, featuring 5 main nights, 5 challenges, a custom night, an endless mode and a few achievements to get!
